title: Unit and counit for the rational projective line
statement:
Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$, $q:P=\mathbf P^1_Y\to Y$, $W=P\times_YP$ with
projections $p_1,p_2:W\to P$ and diagonal $\Delta:P\to W$, and let
$\delta_\Lambda:\Delta_*\Lambda_P\to\Lambda_W(1)[2]$ and
$\operatorname{Tr}_q:Rq_*\Lambda_P(1)[2]\to\Lambda_Y$ be the morphisms of
[sk-prop-diagonal-tower]. All functors below are the restrictions to the
categories $\Loc(\Dbc(-,\Lambda))$.

1. For $M\in\Loc(\Dbc(P,\Lambda))$ there is a natural isomorphism
   $\Delta_*M\simeq p_1^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}\Delta_*\Lambda_P$.
2. The *unit* $\eta_M:M\to q^*Rq_*M(1)[2]$ is the composite
   $$
   M=Rp_{2*}\Delta_*M\simeq Rp_{2*}(p_1^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}\Delta_*\Lambda_P)
   \xrightarrow{Rp_{2*}(1\otimes\delta_\Lambda)}Rp_{2*}\bigl(p_1^*M(1)[2]\bigr)
   \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }q^*Rq_*M(1)[2],
   $$
   the last arrow being the inverse of the proper base change isomorphism
   $q^*Rq_*\to Rp_{2*}p_1^*$ for the cartesian square formed by $p_1,p_2,q,q$.
3. The *counit* $\varepsilon_K:Rq_*q^*K(1)[2]\to K$ for
   $K\in\Loc(\Dbc(Y,\Lambda))$ is the composite of the projection formula
   isomorphism $Rq_*q^*K(1)[2]\simeq K\otimes^{\mathbf L}Rq_*\Lambda_P(1)[2]$
   with $1\otimes\operatorname{Tr}_q$.

Both are natural transformations of exact functors on these localizing
categories.

proof.text:
Well-definedness. (1) Both sides are supported on the diagonal: restricted to
the open complement $W\smallsetminus\Delta$ both vanish, and applying
$\Delta^{-1}$ both become $M$, since $p_1\Delta=\mathrm{id}$ and
$\Delta^{-1}\Delta_*\Lambda_P=\Lambda_P$. The natural map
$p_1^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}\Delta_*\Lambda_P\to\Delta_*\Delta^{-1}(p_1^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}\Delta_*\Lambda_P)=\Delta_*M$
(unit of $\Delta^{-1}\dashv\Delta_*$) therefore restricts to isomorphisms on
the diagonal and on its complement, and these restrictions are jointly
conservative (Stacks, Tag 09AD). Also $Rp_{2*}\Delta_*=R(p_2\Delta)_*=\mathrm{id}$.
(2) $Rp_{2*}$ is proper direct image, so all objects lie in the localizing
categories, and the proper base change map for the square
$q\circ p_1=q\circ p_2$ is an isomorphism on $\Loc(\Dbc(-,\Lambda))$ by
[sk-thm-sf-pf-field]. (3) The projection formula on the localizing
categories is [sk-thm-sf-pf-field]; it is natural in $K$, and
$1\otimes\operatorname{Tr}_q$ is natural in $K$. The construction is the one
used for torsion coefficients (compare [def-amb-p1-trace]), now with the
$\ell$-adic class and trace. Each constituent is a natural transformation of
exact functors, hence so are the composites.
